lines.en: : Hah...
And so another[school] day comes to a close.
Originally, the plan was for me to go to karaoke again with Ami, Ayane, and Maya but...
Well, one of the three (And I’m sure you can guess which one) succeeded in un-inviting me this time.
As it turns out, Maya can be incredibly persuasive when she wants to be.
I guess I must just be immune to her powers or something, though, because she hasn’t managed to dissuade me from visiting her yet.
But, either way, now I’m alone and wandering the streets, trying to find some way to kill the time.
Who the fuck even knows?
I’m just walking around. Life is good.
And by good I mean passable.
That’s right.
Life is passable.
You heard it here first.
: Ooooh, who is that cute boy I spot off in the distance?
: Hm?
I turn around to find Sara and...Haruka hanging out at the same bistro that Ami and Maya frequent?
: Hey. What’s going on?
: The two of us are just catching up on old times. Fancy meeting you here~
: Likewise...Hey, Haruka. What’s up?
: Hey! I’m surprised you two know each other.
: I was actually just thinking the same thing.
: He’s the one I was telling you about on the phone...
: Huh? The one you were telling me about on the-
: Ah-
: You didn’t...
: Whaaaat? Girls talk about stuff~ Are you embarrassed of me?
Haruka’s clearly flustered or embarrassed or...shocked. I don’t know. Haruka is something.
I hope this doesn’t change her opinion of me too much.
: If it makes you feel any better, I only had good things to say~
: Yeah...very good things...
: Are you jealous?
: N-no! I’m just surprised! You would be too if you found out two people you see all the time have been...you know.
: Having sex?
: You haven’t changed at all since [high_school], have you?...
: You two went to [high_school] together?
: We sure did.
: He’s my daughter’s [high_school] teacher.
: Oh, really? She must be in the same class as one of my employees then.
: Oooh is that so? Can you tell us if those two are friends or not?
: I haven’t heard Sana talk about anyone other than you and the blonde girl, so I’m starting to worry that she’s a bit of a wallflower.
Strange that she mentions that...
Sana and Rin sit right next to each other and I feel like the two of them would get along if they actually talked.
I know both of them play games and...wear mostly black so like...
They’d be destined to be good friends, right? Is that how it works?
: I don’t think they are. But maybe I’ll try to push them together if I ever have the chance.
: Please do! Sana needs all the help she can get.
: She definitely seems a little more outgoing lately thanks to you, though...
: Yeah, Rin too when she’s not...you know.
: Oh, I know...
: How do you two know each other, by the way?
: High school!
: Really? Were you in the same class or something?
: Not quite.
: Haru was a few years ahead of me but the two of us used to hang out with some of the same people.
: And now we’re both running small businesses. Who’d have thought things would turn out like this?
: Of course Haruka’s is taking off while mine is imploding, though...
: Oh, stop. We’re not taking off...Besides, I’m sure the bar will get better in no time at all.
: Please spend all of your money there. I need it.
: Well...I can’t spend all of my money there...I still have bills and whatnot.
: Sensei~ Tell Haru-chan to be nice and spend all of her money on me...
: Um...Why do you call him Sensei?...
: You should try it! It’s actually pretty fun. It makes me feel [young]again.
: You are young, though...
: Just do it! Come on! I promise, you’ll love it.
Haruka makes eye contact with me, trying to figure out if this is an acceptable thing for her to do or not.
Frankly, I don’t care.
I’ve gotten used to everyone calling me Sensei over the last few months anyway.
: Nope. Can’t do it. We’re like the same age. It feels weird.
: Come on! It’s like roleplay! I thought you were into stuff like that!
: S-Sara! What the fuck?!
: Hehehe~ Woops...
: Please forget that you just heard that. It’s not true. I swear.
: Really? I don’t think there’s any shame in roleplay. It can actually be kind of fun at times.
: Oh-ho-ho...What an interesting development this has turned out to be...
: Greetings once more, attractive human females. How is-
: Ah! It’s you again!
: Hamburger Man!
: Hamburger Man?...
: I ordered a hamburger from some diner she works at once.
: You said strange things to me!
: I did no such thing...
: You did!
: I did not...
: You did!
: My, you’re pretty popular around here, aren’t you?
: I guess so...
: Greetings once more, attractive human females. Is there anything else I can get for you?
A girl, probably a few years older than Ami, crouches down at the table and checks on Sara and Haruka, albeit in a rather...strange manner.
I’m surprised that this place would hire someone with a tattoo as huge as that on her chest.
Not that I have anything against tattoos, it's just sort of frowned upon in Japan.
: I think we’re okay for now, Kaori. Please keep up the good work.
: I’m okay, too. Thanks, though.
: You! With the face. Order food now.
: All of us have faces...
: Your face is different! It interests me!
: A dog-food?
: Yes. I can not obtain a “dog” until I have the nutrients required to nurture it.
: Why are you putting quotation marks around everything?
: Order food or perish...
: I’ll have a burger.
: Of course you will...
: Kaori will collect this item for you...Please prepare the currency you will use in exchange for it.
: Thanks...
: She’s a little, uhh, eccentric...don’t you think?
: I like her. I think she’s fun.
: I don’t know if I’m fully convinced that she’s human yet.
: Same. I like her tattoo, though. I wish I could pull off something like that.
: You totally could. Maybe not a spider but like...I don’t know. A sparrow or something?
: No way. My boobs are too big. It would look like a pterodactyl.
: Maybe I could get something on my thigh, though...That might be cute.
: What do you think? Do you like tattoos on women?
Absolutely
: Oh, definitely. I love them.
: Really?
: Yup. If you want one, I say go for it. You’re already attractive, so I imagine a tattoo would make you even hotter.
: Hey...I want attention too, you know.
Not really
: Ehh...I’m not really a fan. I think girls are more attractive when they don’t modify their bodies.
: Boo...
: Hahaha...I think they can work on certain people. I just don’t think I’m cut out for one.
: Did you just...shoo me?
: Heheh~ I’ll make it up to you. Don’t worry...
: I’m going to hold you to that.
: Umm...I’m sorry for Sara’s...directness.
: You don’t need to apologize. I’m just happy knowing her daughter hasn’t taken after her.
: Sensei is always so mean to me~
: Tell him to stop, Haru-chan...
: I...don’t think he’s going to listen to me...
I hang around until my burger arrives and then promptly have it boxed to take home.
It’s weird how two of the only people my age that I’ve associated with in Kumon-mi happen to be old friends from[school].
I think they work well together, though. Albeit in a strange sort of way.
I wonder what the two of them were like back then?...
